page: Amazon Web Services i8ge.2xlarge is a storage-optimized instance powered by the AWS Nitro hypervisor and an ARM64-based AWS Graviton processor. Specifically, it features 8 dedicated physical cores utilizing the ARMv9 Neoverse-V2 architecture running at 2.8 GHz. The CPU configuration includes 64 KB L1D cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and 36 MB L3 cache. It is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding 8.0 GB per core, and includes a bundled 5000 GB NVMe SSD local storage volume. Baseline network bandwidth is rated at 8 Gbps.

In benchmark testing, the instance exhibits strong memory performance, achieving a top-tier rating in the Passmark memory score and a strong result in large-block read-only memory bandwidth at 189.45 GB/sec. Single-threaded bzip3 decompression also registers in the top 25%. Most other compute metrics, including stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU tests, Geekbench scores, and Redis SET operations, fall within the average range. However, cryptographic performance is weak, as evidenced by the Passmark CPU encryption test, and LLM inference tasks show mixed results, with medium-model prompt processing scoring in the bottom 10%.

From a resource density perspective, the i8ge.2xlarge offers high qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring substantial local storage and memory relative to compute cores. The 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and 5000 GB of NVMe SSD make it highly suitable for storage-intensive and database workloads. It is well-suited for hosting relational databases, NoSQL databases, caching layers, and data-processing pipelines that benefit from high-speed local storage and large memory footprints, while avoiding workloads heavily reliant on specialized x86 vector instructions or intensive cryptographic operations.
description: Amazon Web Services i8ge.2xlarge is an ARM64 storage-optimized instance powered by an 8-core AWS Graviton Neoverse-V2 processor running at 2.8 GHz. Built on the Nitro hypervisor, it features 64.0 GB of memory and a bundled 5000 GB NVMe SSD for high-capacity local storage. The instance delivers strong memory performance, highlighted by a top-tier Passmark memory score and 189.45 GB/sec large-block read-only memory bandwidth. While general compute, database operations, and web serving benchmarks perform in the average range, cryptographic and certain LLM inference tasks show weaker relative performance. Given its high storage-to-vCPU and memory-to-vCPU ratios, the i8ge.2xlarge is qualitatively cost-efficient for data-dense environments. It is highly suited for storage-intensive workloads, relational and NoSQL databases, and caching applications requiring fast local NVMe storage.
